key_findings: Remifentanil infusion combined with incisional surgery produces bilateral mechanical hypersensitivity (RIH) in mice.
c-Fos expression in the vlPAG is upregulated in RIH; both vlPAG-Glu and vlPAG-GABA neurons participate in RIH regulation.
Chemogenetic activation of vlPAG-Glu or inhibition of vlPAG-GABA neurons alleviates RIH hypersensitivity.
In RIH, vlPAG-Glu neurons show enhanced postsynaptic function and intrinsic excitability; vlPAG-GABA neurons show increased intrinsic excitability and reduced presynaptic inhibition.
Behavioral output depends on the relative balance of vlPAG-Glu and vlPAG-GABA activity.
